🚀 altersend | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Direct, secure, and unlimited file transfer between personal devices without relying on cloud services.
✨ Key Features: • No accounts required • No cloud storage, direct P2P transfer • End-to-end encrypted • No file size limits • Receive files directly in a browser
📖 Summary: AlterSend is an open-source application designed for direct, peer-to-peer file transfer between devices. It bypasses cloud storage entirely, ensuring end-to-end encryption, no size limits, and no account requirements for a private and instant file-sharing experience across multiple platforms.
